latin: Potest uideri essentia sine personis, et una persona sine alia.

mentions.context: false.6 This is exactly what we have in Pico’s thesis. Francis goes on and demon- strates further different components of this proposition but this is beyond the scope of the present discussion. The relations between ‘essence’ and ‘Persons’ is discussed in thesis 2. This topic brings us of course to the subtleties of Trinitarian theology.
